images.title: 4075 as a sum of place values
images.purpose: Shows that every place value except the units is a multiple of 10, so only the units digit decides divisibility by 10.
images.composition: Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no characters, no extra text. The number on top, and below it four boxes in a row joined by plus signs.
images.exact_structure: At the top centre, large: 4075. Below it, four rounded boxes in one row joined by plus signs: 4 × 1000, 0 × 100, 7 × 10 and 5. The first three boxes are filled pale teal (#0072B2) and share one teal (#0072B2) brace underneath labelled multiples of 10. The fourth box, holding 5, has a thick vermilion (#D55E00) outline, with the label only this digit decides under it. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec

images.takeaway: In 4075 every place value except the units is a multiple of 10, so the units digit alone decides.
images.description: Shows that every place value except the units is a multiple of 10, so only the units digit decides divisibility by 10.

image_decisions.why: Splitting the number into place value boxes shows why only the units digit matters for 10.
